title: The Wickedest City Swallowed by the Sea
hook: An earthquake sank two-thirds of Port Royal into the ocean.

scenes.text: In the late 1600s, Port Royal, Jamaica was nicknamed 'the wickedest city on earth'—the lawless pirate capital of the Caribbean.
